transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I... well, I was told to come in. It's work. I'm a cashier, and... lately I just get stuck. Like, I'll be at the register and I just start tapping the scanner. Over and over in this pattern. Or I'll just stop moving entirely, with my hand hovering over the cash drawer, even though someone is standing right there waiting to pay. It doesn't make sense, but I can't seem to stop it. They... they wrote me up for it last week.
When you start tapping the scanner in that pattern, does it feel like something bad will happen unless you do it just right?
No... it's not like that. I don't feel afraid of anything happening. I just... do it.
When this happens, do you feel unable to control your body?
I... I don't really know. I haven't thought about it like that. I just... it just happens. I haven't really noticed.
Have you always found it hard to understand or connect with other people?
I don't... I wouldn't say that. I just... I go to work and do my job. I don't really spend much time thinking about it.
If someone moves your arm into a new position, does it tend to stay there for a while on its own?
I... no one really does that. Moves my arms around, I mean. So... I wouldn't really know. I don't think so.
Right before you start tapping the scanner, do you feel a buildup of tension or an urge that eases when you do it?
I don't... I don't really feel anything like that. It's just... I just tap it. There's no... no buildup or anything. I just do it.
When this happens, do you sometimes find that you can’t speak or barely speak?

I don't... it's not that I can't speak. I just get stuck. At the register. Doing things that... don't really fit what I'm supposed to be doing right then. Like I'll just freeze with my hand hovering over the cash drawer, and the customer is just... waiting. It actually got me written up last week. That's... why I came in.
Have you been hearing voices that other people can't hear?

I... yes. I guess so. Most days, actually. It sounds like... a couple of people talking, just off to the side. Sometimes they call my name from the stockroom, or... or they tell me I rang something up wrong. But when I look, there's no one there. And the customers... they never seem to hear it.
Do you believe someone is controlling your movements?
No. I... no. Nobody is controlling me. It's just my own body. I just... get stuck sometimes, like I said.
When you freeze in one position, does your body tend to stay in that exact position for a while even if it would be uncomfortable?
I don't... no. I don't think so. I just stop moving. I haven't really noticed if it's uncomfortable. I'm just... standing there.
When you get stuck or start tapping, does it stop if something suddenly distracts you?
I don't know. I haven't really paid attention to that.
When someone tries to get you moving again during one of these episodes, do you resist them?
I don't... no one really tries to do that. I'm usually just by myself. So... I wouldn't really know.
Have you been feeling emotionally flat, like your face and feelings don’t show much even when things happen?

I guess... maybe. When people ask what’s wrong, I mostly just shrug. I can’t really find much to say. It's not that I don't care... I still care about my wife and kids. I just don't seem to have the push anymore. Like, to call my son at college, or... meet up with the kayak group. I don't even work on my little repair projects. I just... don't have the push.
